metadata.title: Cognizant Technology Solutions Corp. stock outperforms competitors on strong trading day - MarketWatch

content.text:
Company Close Updates
Cognizant Technology Solutions Corp. stock outperforms competitors on strong trading day
Shares of Cognizant Technology Solutions Corp. CTSH rallied 6.21% to $43.94 Tuesday, on what proved to be an all-around poor trading session for the stock market, with the S&P 500 Index SPX falling 0.45% to 7,503.85 and Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA falling 0.25% to 52,925.15.
Cognizant Technology Solutions Corp. closed 49.51% below its 52-week high of $87.03, which the company reached on January 14th.
